name: artifact
description: Create only on explicit operator request; update requested Artifacts instead of duplicating them. List or rename existing Artifacts. Edit the returned working path; git commit publishes automatically. Restore with git restore --source=<sha>, then commit. File tools/bash expand $CHAT_DATA_DIR. Documents use index.md; apps use index.html with local imports, bundled by Bun. Apps have no network/browser storage; use theme CSS vars (var(--bg), var(--text), var(--accent), var(--chart-1)). Commit output reports publication/app checks; fix problems and recommit. Read wide/narrow screenshots. Link [Title](#artifact=ID).

from_file.description: Source .md/.html for create; relative to cwd.

all.description: List all Artifacts (default: this agent only).
